evocation-cast-ignite: Hold to cast Ignite, let go to light what you aim at
evocation-cast-quench: Hold to cast Quench, let go to put out fire or freeze water
evocation-cast-tremor: Hold to cast Tremor, let go to raise the ground
evocation-cast-gale: Hold to cast Gale, let go to push away what you aim at
evocation-cast-bloom: Hold to cast Bloom, let go to hurry a plant on
evocation-cast-wither: Hold to cast Wither, let go to wither what you aim at
evocation-cast-rewind: Hold to cast Rewind, let go to turn back spoiling food
evocation-cast-progress: Hold to cast Progress, let go to move slow changes on
